Method of Attack: SQL injection vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to read the site’s database by manipulating unsanitized cookie input in the is_user_admin function
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using WP Fastest Cache plugin versions before 1.2.2
Attack Vector: Manipulation of the $username cookie value to alter SQL queries executed by the plugin
Date of Discovery: November 26, 2023 (disclosure date implied by PoC release date November 27, 2023)
